name: Lyo.Email.Models
tagline: Shared models, options, error codes, and event arguments for the `Lyo.Email` SMTP service.
description: Shared models, options, error codes, and event arguments for the [`Lyo.Email`](../Lyo.Email/README.md) SMTP service.

sections.title: What ships in this package — Request / result records
items: `EmailRequest` — sender, recipients, subject and optional attachment metadata used as the `Result<EmailRequest>.Data` payload.

`EmailAttachment` — file name and bytes, plus optional `FileStorageId`, `TemplateId`, `ContentType`, and `MetadataJson` slots for audit and templating correlation. Attachment bytes are not persisted by the logging schema.

`EmailResult` — `Result<EmailRequest>` specialisation that adds `MessageId`, `SentDate`, and `SmtpResponse`. Constructed via `EmailResult.FromSuccess`, `EmailResult.FromException`, and `EmailResult.FromError`.

sections.title: What ships in this package — Options
items: `EmailServiceOptions` — configuration for `EmailService` (host, port, SSL, default sender, optional SMTP credentials, metrics toggle, `BulkEmailConcurrencyLimit` (default `10`), `MaxBulkEmailLimit` (default `1000`), `MaxAttachmentCountPerEmail` (default `20`)). Section name constant: `EmailServiceOptions.SectionName = "EmailServiceOptions"`.

`EmailServiceOptionsValidator` — `IValidateOptions<EmailServiceOptions>` enforcing required `Host`, port range `1..65535`, required `DefaultFromAddress`/`DefaultFromName`, and `MaxAttachmentCountPerEmail > 0`.

sections.title: What ships in this package — Error codes
rows: The SMTP send raised an exception.
The builder failed to build a message.

sections.title: What ships in this package — Event arguments
items: `EmailSentEventArgs(Result<EmailRequest> EmailResult)` — after a single send (success or failure).
`EmailBulkSendingEventArgs(IReadOnlyList<EmailRequest> BulkEmailMessage)` — before a bulk send begins.
`BulkEmailSentEventArgs(BulkResult<EmailRequest> BulkEmailResult)` — after a bulk send completes.
`ConnectionTestedEventArgs(bool IsSuccess, TimeSpan ElapsedTime, Exception? Exception)` — after `TestConnectionAsync` completes.
